import sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"tests")
from test_native_capital_native import NativeCapitalAdverseStateTests as T
T.setUpClass()
try:
 t=T("test_reversal_keeps_distinct_claim_service_and_registered_residual")
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="review-prior-claim-") as tmp:
  with t.open(Path(tmp)/"account.sqlite") as a:
   t.settle(a)
   a.execute("claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","amount":50000,"kind":"covered"},3)
   a.execute("event",{"id":"o","event_id":"subsequent-reversal","action":"late_reversal"},4)
   s=a.snapshot()["summary"]
   assert (s["tailReserve"],s["payables"])==(150000,50000),s
   a.execute("resolve_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"pay1","resolution":"pay"},5)
   a.execute("recover_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"recover1","amount":50000,"source_tx":"prior-recovery"},5)
   before=a.snapshot()["summary"].copy()
   try:a.execute("recover_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"recover2","amount":1,"source_tx":"prior-recovery"},6)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError("duplicate recovery accepted")
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]==before
   try:a.execute("mature",{"id":"o"},20)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError("inclusive boundary released")
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]["tailReserve"]==150000
   a.execute("mature",{"id":"o"},21)
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]["tailReserve"]==100000
   assert a.audit()["accepted"]
   print({"prior_claim_survives_reversal":True,"duplicate_recovery_rejected":True,"inclusive_maturity_boundary_preserved":True,"matured_residual":100000,"audit_accepted":True})
finally:T.tearDownClass()

from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"tests")
from test_native_capital_native import NativeCapitalAdverseStateTests as T
T.setUpClass()
try:
 t=T("test_reversal_keeps_distinct_claim_service_and_registered_residual")
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="review-prior-claim-") as tmp:
  with t.open(Path(tmp)/"account.sqlite") as a:
   t.settle(a)
   a.execute("claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","amount":50000,"kind":"covered"},3)
   a.execute("event",{"id":"o","event_id":"subsequent-reversal","action":"late_reversal"},4)
   s=a.snapshot()["summary"]
   assert (s["tailReserve"],s["payables"])==(150000,50000),s
   a.execute("resolve_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"pay1","resolution":"pay"},5)
   a.execute("recover_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"recover1","amount":50000,"source_tx":"prior-recovery"},5)
   before=a.snapshot()["summary"].copy()
   try:a.execute("recover_claim",{"id":"o","claim_id":"prior-covered","settlement_id":"recover2","amount":1,"source_tx":"prior-recovery"},6)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError("duplicate recovery accepted")
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]==before
   try:a.execute("mature",{"id":"o","event_id":"early-attempt"},20)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError("inclusive boundary released")

   a.execute("mature",{"id":"o","event_id":"actual-maturity"},21)
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]["tailReserve"]==100000

   else:raise AssertionError("second maturity accepted")
   assert a.snapshot()["summary"]==after
   assert a.audit()["accepted"]
   print({"prior_claim_survives_reversal":True,"duplicate_recovery_rejected":True,"inclusive_maturity_boundary_preserved":True,"valid_later_maturity_succeeds":True,"second_maturity_rejected":True,"matured_residual":100000,"audit_accepted":True})

import copy,resource,shutil,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"tests")
from test_native_source_upgrade import NativeSourceUpgradeTests as T, CONTRACT
from commercial.terms import prospective_terms
T.setUpClass()
t=T("test_pristine_old_verifier_transition_preserves_account_money_and_obligations")
try:
 t.setUp()
 ticket=t.authorize()
 untouched=copy.deepcopy(ticket)
 t.a=t.upgrade(ticket)
 fallback=t.new/"historical-source-versions"/ticket["body"]["from_source"]["sha256"]
 fallback.parent.mkdir()
 shutil.move(str(t.old),str(fallback))
 assert not t.old.exists()
 assert t.a.audit()["accepted"]
 t.a.close();t.a=t.reopen()
 a=t.a
 job=next(j for j in t.manifest["jobs"] if j["service_id"]=="reconciliation" and j["accepted"])
 terms=prospective_terms("new-prospective",1000000,10,5)
 a.execute("register_terms",{"id":"new-terms","terms":terms},4)
 a.execute("wallet",{"buyer":"new-buyer","amount":1000000},4)
 a.execute("offer",{"id":"new-prospective","buyer":"new-buyer","price":1000000,"job_id":job["id"],"deadline":8,"terms_id":"new-terms"},4)
 for action,day in [("consent",4),("fund",4),("prepare",5),("release",5)]:
  a.execute("event",{"id":"new-prospective","action":action,"event_id":"new-"+action},day)
  used=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_utime+resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_stime+resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_utime+resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_stime
  assert used<26,("independent-test-budget-near-boundary",used)
 assert a.snapshot()["summary"]["tailReserve"]==101400000
 a.execute("mature",{"id":"new-prospective","event_id":"new-maturity"},11)
 assert a.snapshot()["summary"]["tailReserve"]==100200000
 assert a.export()["source_transitions"]["upgrade-1"]==untouched
 assert a.audit()["accepted"]
 print({"ordinary_account_upgraded":True,"historical_original_path_absent":True,"portable_inventory_fallback_audited":True,"new_prospective_order_collected":True,"old_permanent_tail_retained":100200000,"signed_ticket_unchanged":True})
finally:
 t.tearDown()
 T.tearDownClass()
